messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- On 2026-04-08, the Atlas team observed that webhooks' request volume halved following the client rollout, and since it was not their service, they flagged it. [valid 2026-04-08 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-08]
- The job scheduler depends on the feature-flags service. [valid 2025-04-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-04-29]
- As of 2026-04-13, the Ember team still owns the reporting service. [valid 2026-04-13 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-04-13-2]
- The billing API depends on the ledger service for invoice postings. [valid 2025-01-09 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-09-2]
- As of 2025-09-30, the billing API depends on the feature flag service. [valid 2025-09-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-09-30]
- The Ember team handed the authentication gateway to Cinder on 2025-09-16; Cinder owns it as of that date. [decision; valid 2025-09-16 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-16-auth-gateway]
    earlier: The Ember team owns the authentication gateway. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-09-16; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20]
- As of 2025-05-15, the pager for webhooks rings the Boreal team instead of the Ember team. [valid 2025-05-15 to now; recorded by handover/2025-05-15-webhooks]
    earlier: As of 2025-03-03, the pager for webhooks rings the Ember team instead of the Boreal team. [valid 2025-03-03 to 2025-05-15; recorded by handover/2025-03-03-webhooks]
- The reporting service no longer depends on the ledger service for the nightly balance export; as of 2025-09-23 it uses the bus as its source. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-23]
    earlier: The reporting service depends on the ledger service for the nightly balance export. [valid 2025-01-21 to 2025-09-23; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-21]
- The Dune team owns the reports pipeline as of 2025-03-20. [valid 2025-03-20 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-03-20]
- The indexer depends on the product catalog for product documents. [valid 2025-01-30 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-30]
- The Boreal team observed on 2025-11-03 that the notification service's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift. [valid 2025-11-03 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-03-2]
- On 2026-03-20, the Boreal team observed that the catalog service's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change. [valid 2026-03-20 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-20-2]
- As of 2025-10-13, the ledger service is owned by Cinder; ownership transferred from the Atlas team on that date. [decision; valid 2025-10-13 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-13-ledger]
    earlier: As of 2025-07-17, the ledger service is owned by the Atlas team. [valid 2025-07-17 to 2025-10-13; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-17]
    earlier: The ledger service is owned by the Atlas team. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-07-17; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- The Cinder team owns the job scheduler as of 2025-09-23, when ownership transferred from the Dune team. [decision; valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]
    earlier: The Dune team owns the job scheduler as of 2025-09-05. [valid 2025-09-05 to 2025-09-23; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-05]
- As of 2025-11-24, the Atlas team owns the bus, having taken it over from the Boreal team. [decision; valid 2025-11-24 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-24-event-bus]
    earlier: The Boreal team looks after the bus. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-11-24; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09]
- The Atlas team owns the image resizer as of 2025-11-26, when ownership transferred from the Ember team. [decision; valid 2025-11-26 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-26-image-resizer]
    earlier: The Ember team owns the image resizer as of 2025-03-20. [decision; valid 2025-03-20 to 2025-11-26; recorded by handover/2025-03-20-image-resizer]
    earlier: The Dune team owns the image resizer. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-03-20; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20]
- As of 2025-12-19, the Atlas team owns the product catalog, having taken it over from the Cinder team. [decision; valid 2025-12-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-19-catalog]
    earlier: Cinder owns the product catalog. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-12-19; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17]
- On 2025-12-31, the Atlas team observed that the feature-flags service's queue depth hit 50,000 following the marketing send, and since it was not their service, they flagged it. [valid 2025-12-31 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-31]
- On 2026-04-16, the Atlas team observed that the ledger service's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change, and since it was not their service, they flagged it. [valid 2026-04-16 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-16]
